source: cockatoo windows 0..210 stride 30, seed 7, local run, champion cfg + loo+masks
caveat: single content source; thresholds are status-quo guards (catch invention worse than champion), not perceptual absolutes; LPIPS not gated (no distribution)

rationale.observed_floor: dist_min - 0.02: candidate may not observe less of the signal than champion ever does
rationale.interp_ceiling: max(2, dist_max): champion legitimately interpolates <=2 fade frames
rationale.loo_p95_max_ceiling: dist_max * 1.2: fills leaning on single observations beyond champion's worst window
rationale.hf_band: [dist_min - 0.08, 1.02]: below = detail destruction; above 1.0 = more HF than clean on untouched pixels = invention
